rounds.sentence: Uma umngane wakho ehamba ebhasini wena usala, uthi kuye, ____!
rounds.explain: Hamba kahle kushiwo kohambayo. Sala kahle kushiwo kosalayo.

rounds.sentence: Uma ufika kubafundi abaningi ekilasini, ubabingelela ngokuthi ____.
rounds.explain: Sawubona kumuntu oyedwa. Sanibonani kubantu abaningi.

rounds.sentence: Uma ufuna ukudlula phakathi kwabantu emnyango, qala ngokuthi ____.
rounds.explain: Uxolo ulusebenzisa uma ucela indlela noma uphazamisa. Ngiyaxolisa ukuxolisa iphutha.
Nasi lihambisana namagama afana nesikhwama. Nansi lihambisana namagama afana nencwadi.
Lena lihambisana namagama afana nemoto. Lona livame kwamanye amabanga ebizo.
Yami lihambisana negama elithi inja. Wami lihambisana nelithi umngane.
Zakho lihambisana negama elithi izicathulo. Akho lihambisana namagama afana namazwi.
Ngoba linikeza isizathu. Ngakho likhombisa umphumela.
Kuphela kusho ukuthi akukho okwengeziwe. Phela igcizelela noma ikhumbuza.
Ababili kubalwa abantu ababili. Kubili kubalwa izinto noma izikhathi ezimbili.
Bobabili kubantu ababili. Kokubili ezintweni ezimbili noma ezinhlangothini zombili.

Laba kubantu abasondelene. Lezi ezintweni eziseduze.
Zonke lihambisana nezinto eziningi. Konke kuvame kokungebaleki noma uma kukhulunywa ngakho konke.

kids.explain: Lapha yindawo eseduze. Lapho ikude kancane.

Bonke lihambisana nabantu abaningi. Wonke alifanele lapha.
Zonke lihambisana nezincwadi. Yonke alifanele lapha.
Ibhayisikili lithi lami. Yami ayivumelani nalo.
Abangani abaningi bathi bami. Wami livame into eyodwa.
Isikole sithi sakho. Wakho alihambisani naleli bizo.
